mechanism.claim: Positive serial persistence in completed five-minute aggressive quote-flow imbalance means urgency is being executed in a sequence rather than one isolated burst. During elevated BTC variation, a fresh upper-tail persistence state should continue in the completed net aggressive-flow direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed eight-hour aggregate aggressive quote-flow imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAFC uses only final-two-hour flow sign and requires price confirmation. Dual-half signed-volume assigns quote turnover by candle return sign and does not read taker fields. Quarter-hour and daily flow candidates aggregate fixed buckets without estimating serial dependence. HVTIFP uses lag-one correlation of 96 continuous taker imbalance observations and no price direction, volume-sign proxy, funding, OI, premium, cross-asset input, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC eight-hour variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent while positive flow persistence enters its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily aggressive-flow serial-persistence onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact unique coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_flow: for each of 96 exact groups, sum quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote; require finite nonnegative values, taker<=quote, and group quote strict positive
features.flow_persistence: ordinary Pearson correlation of imbalance[0:95] and imbalance[1:96], finite strict positive
features.persistence_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.net_flow: (2*sum all taker_buy_quote-sum all quote_asset_volume)/sum all quote_asset_volume, finite strict nonzero
features.btc_returns: 95 close-to-close natural-log returns from 96 five-minute closes
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared btc_returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid predecessor cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all flow and price minutes complete
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, imbalance, correlation, history, rank, onset, variation, net-flow side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
